purpose: Teach: 本稿/索引/貯蔵/税源/不服/優待/競売/課金

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業界紙の本稿を読み比べましょう
lines.en: Let's compare the articles from the industry publications side by side.
lines.style: Efficient, matter-of-fact. Quick tempo. Opening with clear authority but not coldness. A directive phrased as collaborative—the 'let's' is genuine, not performative.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。書類索引を社内ポータルに掲載しました
lines.en: Yes. I've posted the document index to the internal portal.
lines.style: Prompt, reliable. Light emphasis on the completion—a quiet satisfaction. Steady eye contact. The tone of someone checking a box and moving forward.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 原材料の貯蔵スペースを拡大しましょう
lines.en: We should expand the raw materials storage space.
lines.style: Clear directive tone. Measured pace, even emphasis. Practical and forward-thinking, not rushed. The voice of someone who has already thought this through.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地方税源の動向を注視しております
lines.en: Yes. I'm keeping close watch on the local tax trends.
lines.style: Steady reporting tone. Slight formality—'I'm keeping watch' carries professional diligence. Not stiff, but precise. The assurance of ongoing attention.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お客様の不服申し立てに迅速対応しましょう
lines.en: We need to respond quickly to customer complaints.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. Opens with quiet urgency. Slight lean forward in the phrasing. Directive without drama—this is a priority, stated cleanly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。会員様への優待企画を進めております
lines.en: Yes. I'm moving forward with the member benefits initiative.
lines.style: Engaged and responsive. The emphasis lands on 'moving forward'—showing progress. Warm professional tone. Not just compliance, but active collaboration.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社員割引で社内競売を実施しましょう
lines.en: Let's run an in-house auction with staff discounts.
lines.style: Energetic but controlled. The directive carries a hint of initiative—slightly more engaging than pure procedure. Tempo picks up subtly. Open, collaborative phrasing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。サブスク課金の試算を出しました
lines.en: Yes. I've run the estimates for subscription billing.
lines.style: Concluding note. Calm and assured. The work is complete and ready. Even, confident delivery. A slight settling in the tone—wrapping up with precision.
